_note: placeholders.json starter (STORYBOARD.md). One plate per AI-footage shot, drawn in code: free, nothing generated. Replace every <FILL: …> hint (draw refuses any left), then `placeholders.py draw`. On each shot that stands on a plate set `bg: assets/plates/<ID>.png`, `bgMove: none`, `bgDim: 0`, `push: 0`, so the board shows the plate as drawn. Coordinates are fractions of the plate. root = the job folder relative to this file (it holds beats.yaml); crops = the other aspects the film is cut to (dashed guides; the label stays inside every crop).

S01.line: <FILL: what the shot shows, in one line, e.g. she walks into the empty office at dawn>
S01.move: <FILL: camera move, e.g. slow push in>
